If you are having issues with Mewtator's launch button, try an alternative launch procedure:
1. Use 'Copy Launch Options' from the File menu
2. Paste them in Steam: Right-click Mewgenics → Properties → Launch Options
3. Launch the game from Steam

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Mewgenics Mod Manager
about.description: Mewtator is a community-made mod manager for Mewgenics, designed to make installing, managing, organizing, and using mods simple and convenient.
about.disclaimer: Mewtator is NOT an official tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developers. Any mods remain the work of their respective authors!
about.credit_game: Special thanks to Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel for creating such an amazing game!
about.credit_intro: Custom game intro created by Sham & CVS!

controls.title: Controls & Shortcuts
controls.subtitle: A quick reference for Mewtator's keyboard and mouse controls.
controls.launch_game: Launch Mewgenics with the currently enabled mods.
controls.toggle_selected: Enable or disable the selected mod.
controls.move_up: Move the selected enabled mod up one position in the load order.
controls.move_down: Move the selected enabled mod down one position in the load order.
controls.move_top: Move the selected enabled mod to the top of the load order.
controls.move_bottom: Move the selected enabled mod to the bottom of the load order.
controls.delete_mod: Delete the selected mod after confirmation.
controls.select_mod: Select a mod and show its details in the preview panel.
controls.toggle_row: Enable or disable the clicked mod row.
controls.reorder_buttons: Move the selected enabled mod one position in the load order.
controls.focus_hint: Mod-list keyboard controls apply while the mod list has keyboard focus. Load-order controls affect enabled mods only.
